description: Read one CMS post. action=get → full body + SEO + taxonomy by post_id (optional include_research / include_blocks). action=get_by_slug → same by site_id + slug. action=performance → GSC metrics, quality scores, health, visitor demand.

action.description: get & performance require post_id; get_by_slug requires site_id + slug.

include_blocks.description: get only: attach a derived blocks array; null with a note if not enabled.

include_research.description: get only: attach the originating research session if any.

post_id.description: Post id. Required for get, performance.

name: cms_post
